profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Goodleap LLC
profile.summary:
I am Zadok Kim, a software engineer from Thousand Oaks, CA with a passion for sustainability and permaculture.
Front-end: JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS, jQuery, Material UI, React-Bootstrap, Next.js
Back-end: Node.js, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Mongoose, Firebase

My passion for code stems from my innate desire to know more about whatever interests me. I have often been called a book full of random information by those who know me well. Want to chat about the Bronze Age Collapse? I'm game. Want to chat about act versus rule utilitarianism? I'm game. How about regenerative agriculture? You get the point. I'm dedicated to test driven development of web and mobile applications. Fast and responsive is the name of the game.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer & Project Manager | Unlocking Wellness
positions.description: A health-care web and mobile app that allows patients to find and assemble a team of providers who are specially trained to care for marginalized communities and people groups.

positions.title: Back-End Engineer | Atelier
positions.description:
Tech Stack: Node.js, Express.js, PostgresQL, Nginx, K6, Newrelic, Loader.io, AWS EC2
Redesigned existing monolithic back-end of ecommerce website into a microservice architecture.
Responsible for horizontally scaling service oriented API.  Benchmarked performance increases from 1,000 RPS to 10,000 RPS.
Utilized Nginx with a least connection load balancing strategy to connect 4 AWS EC2 instances of the server.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer | KYF - Know Your Farmer
positions.description:
Tech Stack: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, React-bootstrap
Created a Full-Stack social media web application to connect Farmers to their customers.

positions.title: Project Catwalk - Front-End Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Stack: React.js, Babel, Webpack, Node.js, AWS EC2, Jest, Enzyme, Express.js
Created the Front-End of an ecommerce web application using modular and reusable React Components. 
Leveraged lazy  loading and HTML preloading to optimize performance, increasing Google Lighthouse scores from 24% to 99%.

positions.title: Farmer's Market Lead
positions.description:
A non-profit biodynamic farm in Espanola, New Mexico
- ran the Sante Fe and Los Alamos Farmers market stands 
-Tripled sales at both markets enabling the organization to better serve the community

positions.title: Independent Sales Representative
positions.description:
Commissions based independent contractor roles
Set company sales records a month into career and trained new hires utilizing best practices resulting in an increase in company sales by 50%
Autonomously generated my own leads and sold products/services directly to the consumers with no oversight

positions.title: Senior Operations Specialist
positions.description:
E-commerce Startup 
Collaborated with a third party engineering team to help define essential calendar widget for the e-commerce app.
Implemented Quality Assurance procedures resulting in the reduction of shipment errors by 80%
